1_classification_curve.temporal_review_flag: set when the three windows do not agree

2_candidate_plateaus.nonzero_plateau_candidates: Method C constant segments, then Rule 3
2_candidate_plateaus.linear_segments: no secondary local-plateau search and no merge
2_candidate_plateaus.global_locking: Rule 7 may label a profile Locking when Method C returns only linear segments

3_valid_plateau.source: user specification, not a gap in the 732-profile histograms
3_valid_plateau.relative_omega_span_definition: (max omega in G - min omega in G) / (max omega - min omega)

4_near_zero_tolerance.definition: an oscillator is near zero when abs(rho) < 0.001

7_locking.definition: max(rho) - min(rho) <= 0.01 on the whole profile
